label: common_2020_esper_020_esper_01
text: Ah, the rush of exhilaration before a battle. Every\ncell in my body is humming with excitement.[VAR 0x0114(001C)]

label: common_2020_esper_020_esper_02
text: Having a totally amazing opponent such as\nyourself makes the feeling even more powerful.[VAR 0x0114(001C)]

label: common_2020_esper_020_esper_03
text: You know what? I’m really happy right now.[VAR 0x0114(001C)]

label: common_2020_esper_020_esper_04
text: A diamond in the rough that I helped to polish\nis now sparkling as bright as the finest of gems.[VAR 0x0114(001C)]

label: common_2020_esper_020_esper_05
text: Seeing others working so hard allows me to work\nhard myself and never shed a tear.[VAR 0x0114(001C)]

label: common_2020_esper_020_esper_06
text: “Sadness” is not in my vocabulary, after all. The\nclosest emotion I allow is the beauty of surprise.[VAR 0x0114(001C)]

label: common_2020_esper_020_esper_07
text: Allow me to teach you how to do true Emotional\nSpectrum Practice![VAR 0x0114(001C)]

label: common_2020_esper_020_esper_08
text: You’re the total package! I expected no less.\nBeauty, strength... You’ve got it all.[VAR 0x0114(001C)]

label: common_2020_esper_020_esper_09
text: You know, in my line of work, people who lack\ntalent in one area or the other often fade away\r\nquickly—never to be heard of again.[VAR 0x0114(001C)]

label: common_2020_esper_020_esper_10
text: Met with all kinds of setbacks, they fall into\ncorruption in their desperation and end up even\r\nmore miserable than the mundane do.[VAR 0x0114(001C)]

label: common_2020_esper_020_esper_11
text: It would be better for those people if they never\nhad even the slightest bit of talent to begin with.[VAR 0x0114(001C)]

label: common_2020_esper_020_esper_12
text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Don’t fade away, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]. I
want
to
see
just
how far your talent can go.[VAR 0x0114(001C)]

label: common_2020_esper_020_esper_13
text: This can be a promise between us. I hope you\nwon’t break it.[VAR 0x0114(001C)]

label: common_2020_esper_020_esper_14
text: You did splendidly today. Thank you for\neverything.[VAR 0x0114(001C)]
